_comment: Context-aware (ABAC) rules, evaluated by auth/dependencies.py. They run alongside the existing role checks in web/auth.py and never replace them. Combining: any matching deny wins, then any matching allow, otherwise deny. A matching rule whose condition attribute is missing denies. Every rule carries an explicit "confirm": true = approved by the owner, false = repaired or interpreted and awaiting owner review (recorded only; it does not change evaluation).
_timezone_comment: IANA zone used to evaluate request_time (business hours). Owner decision (Task 7): Asia/Baghdad (UTC+3, no DST). The server's local zone is never used (Render runs in UTC). Override with the ABAC_TIMEZONE env var; an invalid ABAC_TIMEZONE logs a warning and falls back to Asia/Baghdad.

rules.note: Repair of analyst-cve-pipeline-critical-only, read half. GET/HEAD on CVE routes (e.g. NVD search) carry no target, so they are allowed without a severity. Export routes (params.cve_export_routes) are excluded and covered by cve_export instead. A missing route denies.

Repair of the overly broad cve_read: GET /api/cve/drafts/{draft_id}/export (web/routers/cve_submission.py:cve_draft_export) exports data and also sets the draft status to exported, so it is admin only. Analysts lose export under ABAC; this narrows a rule, it does not remove the feature. To revert, drop the route condition from cve_read and delete this rule. Admin is also covered by cve_admin; this rule makes the export grant explicit.

Repair of analyst-cve-pipeline-critical-only, write/run half. resource_severity is Finding.severity of the finding_id the request targets (Target has no severity column). No target, or a CVE-only request (no verified CVSS->severity mapping), means no severity, so deny.
Keeps admin aligned with the live role logic: CVE routes have no role check, so admin is not narrowed here. Without it the default deny would block admin.
Roadmap: viewer -> SQLi scan denied unless from an internal network. Resource rebound from the abstract 'sqli_scan' to api_scan = POST /api/scan (web/app.py:run_scan).

Repair of viewer-sqli-scan-internal-allow. Viewer may launch only SQLi-class checks (params.sqli_class_checks), judged on scan_checks = scan_authz.expand_checks(scan_types), never the raw list: empty or missing scan_types expands to every module, SQLi included, so it never matches; a failed expansion leaves scan_checks missing and denies, only from an internal network, and only on a target web/scan_authz.decide() authorizes. run_scan's require_analyst_or_admin still blocks viewers live, so this rule cannot widen access. Owner decision (least privilege): the match stays strict subset_of, so a mixed list such as [sqli, xss, nmap] is denied even from an internal network on an authorized target; do not loosen it to an intersects/contains check.

Roadmap: any role -> NGFW Rules denied outside configured business hours. Resource = GET /ngfw/api/rules (web/routers/ngfw.py:73), the only NGFW rules endpoint. Window: params.business_hours (Sun-Thu, start inclusive, end exclusive) in the ABAC_TIMEZONE zone, else config 'timezone'.
Counterpart of the deny rule; without it the default deny would block NGFW Rules at all hours. Confirmed by the Task 4 spec (Sunday 09:00 / Thursday 10:00 must allow).
